name: Maha Vishagarbha Taila (Oil)

sections.introduction: Maha Vishagarbha Taila (Oil) is an ayurvedic formulation which is formulated from many herbs. This is known to control the aggravated vata and related disorders. This is very helpful to treat problems related with neuro-muscular conditions.
sections.ingredients:
Murchita til taila (6.3 litres) – Sesamum indicum seed oil 
 All following ingredients take up to 240 grams:- 
 Ashudha shringk vish 
 Ashudha kuchla – Nux Vomica 
 Arkamool – Calotropis gigantea 
 Arandmool – Ricinus communis 
 Dhatura ka panchang – Datura stramonium 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take all the ingredients and make their kalka. Take 20 litres water and add all the above ingredients in it. 
 Put in a container and cook to make taila. 
 After completion, strain the liquid and store in a jar. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Maha Vishagarbha Taila is an herbal oil used to manage the vata disorders. It is used for external application. It is used to manage the neuro-muscular conditions in body. Being anti-inflammatory in action, this oil works well to lessen the limbs and back pain. Application of this oil helps to improve sensations in lack of tactile sensations. In tenants, it helps to relieve the muscles stiffness. This oil works well to resolve the continuous noise or ringing in tinnitus. Whereas in sciatica, massage of this oil helps to manage the symptoms like numbness, tingling, and weakness in legs.
sections.indications:
Vata dosha related diseases 
 Sciatica 
 Limbs and back pain 
 Tetanus 
 Tinnitus 
 Lack of tactile sensations 

 Usage 

 This is for external use. 
 Take the oil and massage with it on affected area.
sections.contraindications:
Avoid in pregnancy and lactation. 
 Take under doctor’s prescription. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Maha Vishagarbha Taila (Oil) 
 Reference – Ayurveda Sara Sangraha, 17th edition, page no. 660. 
 Introduction 
 Maha Vishagarbha Taila (Oil) is an ayurvedic formulation which is formulated from many herbs. This is known to control the aggravated vata and related disorders. This is very helpful to treat problems related with neuro-muscular conditions. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Murchita til taila (6.3 litres) – Sesamum indicum seed oil 
 All following ingredients take up to 240 grams:- 
 Ashudha shringk vish 
 Ashudha kuchla – Nux Vomica 
 Arkamool – Calotropis gigantea 
 Arandmool – Ricinus communis 
 Dhatura ka panchang – Datura stramonium 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take all the ingredients and make their kalka. Take 20 litres water and add all the above ingredients in it. 
 Put in a container and cook to make taila. 
 After completion, strain the liquid and store in a jar. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Maha Vishagarbha Taila is an herbal oil used to manage the vata disorders. It is used for external application. It is used to manage the neuro-muscular conditions in body. Being anti-inflammatory in action, this oil works well to lessen the limbs and back pain. Application of this oil helps to improve sensations in lack of tactile sensations. In tenants, it helps to relieve the muscles stiffness. This oil works well to resolve the continuous noise or ringing in tinnitus. Whereas in sciatica, massage of this oil helps to manage the symptoms like numbness, tingling, and weakness in legs. 
 Indications 
 
 Vata dosha related diseases 
 Sciatica 
 Limbs and back pain 
 Tetanus 
 Tinnitus 
 Lack of tactile sensations 
 
 Usage 
 
 This is for external use. 
 Take the oil and massage with it on affected area. 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Avoid in pregnancy and lactation. 
 Take under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
